text.p: - Montgomery Securities Analyst Jonathan Joseph said he raised his rating on Texas Instruments Inc from HOLD to BUY Tuesday.

- Joseph said he expects the company to earn $2.00 per share in Fiscal Year (December) 1996 and $3.75 per share in Fiscal Year 1997. His target price is $65, or approximately 23 percenty above current levels.

- Joseph said he upgraded his rating on the company due to the following: he believes the DRAM suppliers are once again either holding price or beginning to raise them; PC vendors are becoming anxious about their Christmas supply; Texas Instruments benefits from a stable DRAM market; and shortages have begun to develop in other component areas.
- Joseph said he also believes that Tom Engibous' recent appointment to CEO is another long-term positive.
